figures.name: Dievas

ability.name: Cosmic Order
ability.description: Restore all debuffed stats to base values for all allies; deal 3 damage to chaos-aligned enemies.

figures.description: Sky father and supreme deity who upholds cosmic order and whose name is related to the Proto-Indo-European divine.

figures.name: Perkūnas

ability.name: Oak Strike
ability.description: Destroy one dark or serpent enemy; deal 5 thunder damage to all remaining enemies.

figures.description: Thundering god of the oak who eternally battles the underworld serpent Velnias, upholding the world's moral order.

figures.name: Velnias

ability.name: Serpent Wisdom
ability.description: Steal all knowledge abilities from one enemy permanently.

figures.description: Shape-shifting underworld god of the dead and magic who steals Perkūnas' cattle and hides below the earth.

figures.name: Laima

ability.name: Fate Decree
ability.description: Look at your deck; rearrange the next 3 cards in any order.

figures.description: Cuckoo-goddess who decrees each person's fate at birth and whose decision even Dievas cannot override.

figures.name: Saule

ability.name: Solar Amber
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; grant +2 to all stats to female/goddess allies.

figures.description: Sun goddess who drives her amber chariot across the sky, weeps amber tears and dances at the solstice.

figures.name: Žemyna

ability.name: Earth's Embrace
ability.description: At the end of each turn, restore 1 HP to all allies for 3 turns.

figures.description: Earth mother goddess honored at every meal with a libation, the most intimately worshipped of all Baltic deities.

figures.name: Eglė the Serpent Queen

ability.name: Serpent Queen's Curse
ability.description: Transform one enemy into a harmless creature for 2 turns.

figures.description: Mortal woman who married the Serpent King of the Sea and whose tragedy transformed her family into trees.

figures.name: Aitvaras

ability.name: Lucky Serpent
ability.description: Steal 2 HP from one enemy and add to one ally's HP.

figures.description: Household spirit appearing as a flying fiery serpent or black rooster who brings grain and gold but demands a price.

figures.name: Meness

ability.name: Silver Horseman
ability.description: Swap any two cards' positions; the card that moves gains +2 speed.

figures.description: Moon god who drives silver horses across the night sky and married the sun goddess, causing the seasonal cycle.

figures.name: Aušrinė

ability.name: Morning Star
ability.description: This card always acts first in a turn; remove one enemy buff at the start of combat.

figures.description: Dawn goddess who kindles the sacred fire each morning and tends the world tree for Saule.

figures.name: Giltinė

ability.name: White Lady's Kiss
ability.description: Mark one enemy: they lose 2 HP at the start of each turn until healed by a light ability.

figures.description: Death goddess who appears as a white lady and licks victims to death with her poison tongue.

figures.name: Ragana

ability.name: Dark Shifter
ability.description: Copy the appearance and stats of one enemy for 1 turn.

figures.description: Baltic witch who shapeshifts into animals and who was once honored as a wise woman before Christian demonization.

figures.name: Medeina

ability.name: Forest Sovereignty
ability.description: All nature and beast enemies lose 2 power; allies gain +2 speed in forest terrain.

figures.description: Virgin goddess of forests and the hunt, depicted with a hare and a crescent moon, mistress of all wild things.

figures.name: Gabija

ability.name: Sacred Hearth
ability.description: Negate the next attack against any ally; restore 2 HP to all allies.

figures.description: Sacred fire goddess of the hearth whose flame must never be extinguished lest misfortune befall the household.

figures.name: Laumė

ability.name: Fairy Spinner
ability.description: Choose one ally's fate: double their next roll or halve an enemy's.

figures.description: Fate fairies who appear bathing in moonlit waters, protect children and weave the thread of human destiny.

figures.name: Bangpūtys

ability.name: Wave Surge
ability.description: Deal 4 water damage to all enemies; 30% chance to knock each one back.

figures.description: God of the Baltic Sea and storms who blows with such force he can swamp entire fleets.

figures.name: Dimstipatis

ability.name: Homestead Ward
ability.description: Prevent the next debuff from affecting any ally this turn.

figures.description: The master spirit of the farmstead who must be welcomed into a new home with offerings of bread and salt.

figures.name: Kaukas

ability.name: Harvest Sprite
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to one ally; grant +1 power to all earth/nature allies.

figures.description: Small grain-spirit who lives in the rye fields and brings abundance to farmers who respect the harvest.

figures.name: Žilvinas

ability.name: Prince's Scales
ability.description: Switch one ally's power and defense stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: Serpent prince from Lithuanian legend who married the mortal Eglė and ruled the underwater kingdom.

figures.name: Vaidevutis

ability.name: Royal Decree
ability.description: Your next 2 abilities cannot be countered by enemy reactions.

figures.description: Legendary first king and high priest of the Baltic peoples who established the sacred flame at Romuva.
